note: Effect chunks of a species' own, appended to ETCHI/EFEDAT.EFE after the disc's 122 (tools/derive/steps/effects.py). Each is a Digimon World 2 technique converted from the player's DW2 disc (tools/dw2efe.py): its cast and hit effect objects, under the disc folder AAA/4.AAA/EFFECT, either [model, anim] (one object at slot 1) or [[DW2 slot, model, anim], ...] (every object of the technique; slot 0 above the head, 1 the launch point or mid height, 2 the feet). Indices no entry uses are left empty. stands_for: the chunk whose launch point (origin table) it takes. scale: DW2 units to this game's (the caster's height here against its DW2 head height); hit_scale: the hit object's, when DW2's close camera made it larger than a battle here shows well. reach: no longer used (the projectile flies to its target). area (optional): hit every enemy, for a range-3 technique; hits (optional): damage events per target. A species plays one with own_effect in its JSON.
